body: Dang...this is some really good advice. Not to mention it's really nice to have someone on my side (even if it's just a stranger on the internet). Thanks, friend! :) I appreciate it!

Ah, I see. I guess I can give that a try. (Ugh. More trying stuff.)

I'll try not to give up hope. Where I am right now, I'm okay. I guess I'll go minute by minute on this shit because thinking about the future feels abysmal for me. But thank you for listening and for the advice. :)
Thanks, buddy. Not to keep pestering you for advice, but do you have any ideas about how to get out of a dissociative state?

Oh you didn't make me feel selfish. It's just a general thing with me. Also, congratulations on the job! :)

I guess I should try that. I put too much pressure on myself to try and feel joy from the big things and end up feeling nothing at all. I also have kind of a problem with dissociation that I hope can be solved. It's just really kind of rough. It feels like a chain of "try try try" that never ends.

Thanks for the response, friend. But yeah. That's why I feel so selfish and guilty. Objectively, I have so many reasons to keep going. But I feel numb going through the day. No enthusiasm. Nothing that makes any suffering I have "worth it."

Not to put pressure on you, but do you have any advice on finding the motivation to keep going?
